_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} michezoni ya LinesOfAction.
Zinthu zako ni '{side}', zinthu za mpinzani ni '{other}'.
Mtundiko wa kuhamisha: `[b1b3]` (kutoka-malo ku-malo). Kuhamisha kwa njia ya sheria ni kwenda mlalo, wima, kapena ulalo kwa idadi ya miraba sawa na jumla ya zinthu (rangilo lolote) mwenye mstari huo. Ungaweza kukwera juu ya zinthu zako, koma si za mpinzani; kutua pamwamba pa mpinzani kukamata.  Ushinde wakati zinthu zako zote ziliunganishwa kwa ukanda wa majirani 8.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mtundu wake uyenera kukhala e2e4 (kuchokera,to coordinates).
invalid_move.identical: Malo agho ghakufumira na uko kukuya ni ghamoza.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Kucita cinthu pa malo ghamoza panji ghaŵiri.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ŵakwenera kwenda mtunda wakuyana na umo viŵiya viliri.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ŵakaŵa na malo ghekha agho ŵakalutanga.

game_action.captured_suffix: Mwami {player_id} wakonzeka {from} -> {to} wakapata mwamuna wa mkonzi.

outcome.draw_no_capture: Ŵakaŵa na malundi 60 kweni ŵakaŵasanga yayi.
